reader.requirement: At --std 85, an RD with no PAGE clause is one page of indefinite length: no page advance ever happens (no form feed, PAGE-COUNTER stays 1), LINE-COUNTER keeps growing past any page size, every group is placed relative to LINE-COUNTER, and the forms that need pages (page heading/footing groups, absolute LINE, NEXT PAGE, absolute NEXT GROUP) are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ReportPageForms2002: a PAGE clause with no integer-1 (only a COLUMNS width) is refused below 2002, so at 85 the only unpaged report is one with no PAGE clause

reader.edition-search: model.Paged is set only by a written integer-1; the runtime's _paged arms (FirstLineTarget GR5c, the page-fit and NEXT GROUP arms) carry no edition test (grep of ReportWriter.cs for Edition/DialectBehavior).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: 2002+ also lets a PAGE clause with only a width leave the report unpaged; 1985 refuses that form. The unpaged behaviour itself is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb484 covers relative placement on an unpaged report; length past 999 lines, PAGE-COUNTER, RH/CF/RF, and the refusals were not exercised

probes.expected: one page: PAGE-COUNTER 1 throughout, LINE-COUNTER grows past 999, RH NEXT GROUP PLUS 2 -> 3, body groups relative

probes.printed: error COBOL0899: TYPE PageHeading requires a PAGE clause that defines the page limit
probes.expected: refused (1985 presentation-table footnote: no page heading without PAGE)

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: the report is not divided into pages, so all its LINE clauses shall be relative
error COBOL2284: only the relative form of the NEXT GROUP clause may be specified
probes.expected: refused (§1985 NEXT GROUP SR3); r3ngabs.cob (NEXT GROUP 5) the same

probes.printed: COBOL2199 (1985 SR9 PF first LINE absolute) and COBOL0899 TYPE PageFooting requires a PAGE clause

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR3  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3

reader.notes: Unpaged is the model's Paged=false flag carried into the runtime as _paged. Every page-related arm is gated on it, and the binder refuses the page-only forms.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85 (refute-1985-039): p3re (RD with no PAGE clause; RH LINE PLUS 1 NEXT GROUP PLUS 2, DE LINE PLUS 1, RF LINE PLUS 2; INITIATE/GENERATE/TERMINATE twice) -> report RH,_,_,001,_,RF,RH,_,_,002,_,RF with no form feed; PAGE-COUNTER 1 throughout, LINE-COUNTER 4 after GENERATE, 6 after TERMINATE, 0 after the second INITIATE: one page of indefinite length, groups placed relative to LINE-COUNTER (NEXT GROUP PLUS honoured). p3rhnp (RF LINE 1 ON NEXT PAGE with no PAGE clause) -> COBOL2199 refused (absolute LINE needs pages). The reader had covered LINE-COUNTER past 999, PH/PF and absolute NEXT GROUP refusals and the 2002 width-only PAGE clause refusal. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR3 'If the PAGE clause is omitted, the report consists of a single page of indefinite length.'
